question.prompt:
The following bar graph represents the length (in letters) of the names of \(19\) people. What is the median length of these names?

[Figure 1](figures/2016_AMC_8_Q06_question_fig1.svg)

solutions.explanation:
Arrange the \(19\) name lengths from shortest to longest. The median is the \(10\)th length, because it has \(9\) lengths before it and \(9\) after it.

The graph shows \(7\) three-letter names and \(3\) four-letter names. Thus positions \(1\) through \(7\) have length \(3\), and positions \(8\) through \(10\) have length \(4\). The \(10\)th length is therefore \(\boxed{4}\) letters, choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
solutions.title: Locate the middle name
